messages:
maria-cs: Heads up — we're seeing elevated onboarding latency for tenants provisioned during last night's EU index migration. About 15 tenants impacted (12 trials + 3 high-touch). Need customer comms, translation, and a proposed credit offer.

ashley-se: Ugh. Can you paste the tenant list and the short root-cause? Do we have an ETA for recovery?

maria-cs: Quick summary: index migration caused a processing backlog; the provisioning worker retried too aggressively and tripped a rate-limiter that wasn't bumped for the migration load. Result: delayed index availability and repeated retries. Tenant list (anonymized): tenant-430, tenant-441, tenant-477, 12 trial ids... I'll DM full list + contacts.

sam-eng: Mitigation in-flight: spun up extra indexer workers, relaxed retry backoff for the provisioning job, and temporarily bypassed the limiter for onboarding traffic. Traffic is catching up; we expect steady state in ~30-45m. Will monitor token-by-token.

neil-ops: Rolled config change to limiter at 17:18 UTC, alerts cleared on the queue depth. I'm watching for regressions. :eyes:

john-vp-cs: For messaging: propose 2 weeks of platform credits + dedicated office hours for the 3 high-touch customers; 1 week of credits + recorded office hours for trials. Also ask product to expedite any manual import needs. Thoughts?

maria-cs: Agree. Draft outbound note below — will localize for FR/DE/ES. Please review edits.

```
Subject: Quick update: onboarding delay and remediation steps from Redwood Inference

Hi <Customer name>,

We wanted to let you know we experienced a provisioning delay for customers onboarded during a scheduled migration in the EU region. Our engineers have implemented a fix and your tenant's index should be available shortly.

What we did: increased processing capacity, fixed a retry configuration, and monitored progress.
What we're offering: 1 week of platform credits (2 weeks for customers on our high-touch plan), and a 1:1 office hours slot over the next 3 business days if you'd like guided help.

We're sorry for the disruption — we'll follow up with a short post-incident summary and a feedback survey so we can improve the onboarding flow.

Best,
The Redwood Inference team
```

ashley-se: Small edit: change "scheduled migration" -> "platform migration" and add a line: "If you have an urgent import need, reply and we'll prioritize." Also can we localize the subject lines?

lina-localization: I'll take FR/DE/ES localization. Give me final subject + body in the next 30m and I'll push translated versions. I can also prepare short CTAs per region (office hours times).

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding latency". Severity: S2. Noted owners: sam-eng, neil-ops, maria-cs.

sam-eng: quick log snippet for context:

```
2026-03-23T17:12:09Z provisioning.worker INFO attempt=7 tenant=tenant-441 status=retrying err="rate_limited: provisioning_window"
2026-03-23T17:12:11Z indexer.queue WARN depth=987 pending=12
2026-03-23T17:14:05Z provisioning.worker INFO attempt=1 tenant=tenant-441 status=success latency=00:02:08
```

neil-ops: Verified backfill completed for 9/15 tenants; remaining 6 are actively catching up. Will post a final tally when all are green.

maria-cs: Plan: I'll send individualized notes to the three high-touch accounts (including credit offer and office hours invites) within 45m. CS-ops will send a bulk note to trials localized per region once Lina posts translations. We'll include a short feedback form and a link to schedule 1:1 if needed.

john-vp-cs: Thanks team. Keep execs copied on any escalations. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: I'll post an update here in 30m and the full RCA in ~24h. If anything changes sooner, ping me directly.
